mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND DATE(o.created_at) = #{day}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status
